程序包 org.bukkit.scoreboard

接口 Team

所有超级接口:
net.kyori.adventure.audience.Audience, net.kyori.adventure.audience.ForwardingAudience, net.kyori.adventure.pointer.Pointered
public interface Team extends net.kyori.adventure.audience.ForwardingAudience
计分板上的队伍, 拥有共同的显示名和其它属性. 此队伍只与 getScoreboard() 获取的计分板相关联.

原文： A team on a scoreboard that has a common display theme and other properties. This team is only relevant to the display of the associated scoreboard.
